backtest_method.normalisation: curly quotes -> straight, '_' emphasis removed, '[...]' elisions removed, whitespace collapsed; case-insensitive regex
backtest_method.hit_rule: a line hits its speaker's card when it matches >= 1 backtest_markers[].regex AND none of forbidden_words[].regex
backtest_method.sample: every spoken source line (type dialogue or thought) whose speaker label is in the card's source_speaker_labels; coverage 100% of spoken lines. type=verse lines are recited or sung texts (poems, the accusation, the anonymous letter) and are excluded from the denominator; they are listed in each card's recitation_repertoire
backtest_method.width_guards: cross_claim_rate = share of the other nine carded characters' spoken lines the card would also claim (too-wide check); lift = hit_rate / cross_claim_rate; attribution_top1_rate = share of own lines where this card has the uniquely highest weighted marker score across all ten cards (forbidden match = veto). The width guards are reported for information; only hit_rate gates acceptance
backtest_method.for_dialogue_rewrite: run the same script with --lines <json list of {speaker_id, text, [id], [type]}> on rewritten screenplay lines; the metric and threshold (>= 0.80 per character) stay identical, so both stations share one definition
backtest_method.count_in_source: catchphrases[].count_in_source = number of spoken source lines containing the phrase (not the number of occurrences)

shared_notes.language: all card content in English (source language and project output language)
shared_notes.anachronism_rule: each card carries the same period-slang forbidden regex (okay/cool/guys/yeah/gonna...), because dialogue-rewrite machine-checks cards one by one
shared_notes.sup_002: dream figures are human performers (SUP-002); animal-coded idioms in their speech (the White Rabbit's 'my ears and whiskers', the Cheshire Cat's growl/purr syllogism) are kept as costume-coded verbal tics, not literal anatomy
shared_notes.sup_014: the Queen's and the Duchess's execution words are bluster only; the cards treat them as verbal reflexes, and no card licenses a carried-out threat
shared_notes.no_narration: the film has no narration; Alice's type=thought lines are kept in her sample because in the realistic adaptation they can only surface as spoken self-talk
shared_notes.inferred_items: CHAR-alice-sister has only two source lines. Her third sentence pattern, her address.self and her drift entry are designed (inferred:true + reason). CHAR-queen-of-hearts address.to_the_king is inferred (inferred:true + reason)
shared_notes.excluded_source_lines: group or uncertain lines are not in any single-character sample: ch007-d0002 (UNKNOWN, 'No room!'), ch007-d0067 (March Hare + Hatter), ch007-d0086 (Hatter + March Hare), ch010-d0084 (UNKNOWN crier)
